As seen on v/mlp when you hover over post items.

/* Margin will not trigger :hover so we change it to padding */
.sitetable .thing {
 margin-bottom: 0;
 padding-bottom: 8px;
}
/* The default top position of your friend (Furthest from the top of the page) */
.sitetable .thing:hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: 0;
}
/* The first item in your results list, we use a negative top value to hide the image under the header */
.sitetable .thing:nth-child(1):hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: -900px;
}
/* Each subsequent item we add an amount to the top */
.sitetable .thing:nth-child(2):hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: -800px;
}
.sitetable .thing:nth-child(3):hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: -700px;
}
.sitetable .thing:nth-child(4):hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: -600px;
}
.sitetable .thing:nth-child(5):hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: -500px;
}
.sitetable .thing:nth-child(6):hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: -400px;
}
.sitetable .thing:nth-child(7):hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: -300px;
}
.sitetable .thing:nth-child(8):hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: -200px;
}
.sitetable .thing:nth-child(9):hover ~ .thing:last-child:before {
 top: -100px;
}
/* On the last item in the list, we add a the image in a before tag and set it's top value to the starting position. */
.sitetable .thing:last-child:before {
 content: "";
 position: absolute;
 top: -1000px;
 height: 1080px;
 width: 150px;
 right: 300px;
 background: url([http://bestpont.com/pinkiespy.png)](http://bestpont.com/pinkiespy.png)) no-repeat;
 transition: top 500ms; /* We smooth out the transistion between each position */
 transition-delay: 250ms;
}

If you want to get more creative you can mess with z-index so your friend will appear behind the items. (Why I used :before instead of :after).
